I just cut off my twin sister Sandy and her pathetic excuse of a husband, Dan and yeah, I said husband, even though they're legally separated they're still living together like it's all normal. It's not. I am 44, been married 12 years. My marriage ain't perfect my husband's cheated a couple times, and we haven't touched each other in over a year. We run a business together, we've got two boys, 11 and 14, and I've been trying to hold my life together while constantly cleaning up everyone else's mess too. Sandy's been erect for years. Back surgeries, weight issues, always on and off pain meds. When she's sober she can be funny and charismatic, sure. But we both got childhood trauma and instead of healing, she's just been leaning on me like I'm her personal nurse, maid, therapist and babysitter. I've cooked, cleaned, taken care of her kid like he was mine while raising my own. And Dan? Where do I even start? Never liked him. Got feeling from the beginning. Last year he sends a deep pick to my husband. Says it was an accident. My husband jokes about it some lame taco joke and laughs it off. I didn't. I saw it for what it was creepy, manipulative, and weird as hell. Fast forward Dan comes out as gay. Cool, whatever but he's still living with Sandy. And when I said I didn't want Dan around my kids, especially after that pick. Sandy calls me a hypocrite. Like excuse me? Because my marriage has problems I'm not allowed to protect my sons from a man who sent an unsolicited photo to their father? Nah. I hit my breaking point. Told her I was done helping. Done pretending everything's fine. Then it got worse. We were at a mutual friend's barbeque. I was sitting on the couch, minding my business, and Dan slithers over, smiling like nothing's wrong, and says I could blackmail you. He then went on about how he could blackmail me about my husband about the affairs. Just like that. I looked at him like are you serious right now? My blood went cold. I grabbed my bag and left with a friend before I lost it. My husband was livid. That quiet, dangerous kind of mad where you don't raise your voice you just act. He didn't even tell me, just got in the car and drove straight to Sandy's house. Said he was done with the games. Dan opened the door all friendly, smiling like nothing happened. Dan tried to be sweet said he had a box of random stuff my boys had left over the years. Which honestly just made it worse. Like why are you saving little boy things for years? The creepiest thing in the box? A darn a part of toilet training potty seat. He acted like he was doing my husband a favor. Like he was the good guy in all this. Like my husband were supposed to thank him or forget what he said to me. My husband told him off. I told my sister that as long as Dan is in her life, I want nothing to do with either of them. She can call me dramatic. She can play victim all she wants. I don't care. I've spent years trying to be the strong one, the helper, the fixer on I am done. This is not about drama.
